_doc: Per-team policy for heal-playwright-suite (production test-rot repair). 'ask' = healed suite stays a drafts/ proposal + diff; a human graduates it. 'trust' = after green x2 the healed suite auto-graduates to live/<team>/functional/ (files copied, NEVER git-committed — the uncommitted diff is the audit surface; revert = git checkout). Missing team key or missing/invalid file = 'ask' (fail-safe). Example: { "default": "ask", "demo-web": "trust" }
